topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: The box sat there, heavier than it looked, as if it held所有的秘密和疑虑. I traced the edges, the writing on it not mine, not anyone’s I knew. It felt wrong, out of place, like a misplaced thought. The air was thick, each breath a struggle. I wondered who this person was, the one who used to live here, whose things still found their way to my door. I didn’t dare open it, imagining what could be inside, relics from a life I barely dared to guess about. The shadows in the corner seemed to deepen, the room growing colder. I glanced at the phone, the urge to call someone, anyone, almost overwhelming. But I didn’t. Instead, I just stood there, the unopened box a silent, unwelcome guest in my home.
